control_profile: Twenty-two percent volatility target only; no position stop, drawdown brake, time stop, or turnover clipping.
falsifier: Reject the family if the nine-week formation neighbor loses doubled-cost edge, role breadth, fold breadth, or regime breadth.
hypothesis: If volatile non-mega-cap overreaction is persistent rather than tied to exactly eight weeks, extending formation to nine weeks should preserve the loser-minus-winner edge.
rebalance_horizon: one weekly cohort with four equally weighted overlapping cohorts
